subject: Taxes
title: Can Tax Revolts Happen Today?
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Can Tax Revolts Happen Today?.

hook.text: Digital-age tax revolts look different: memes replace muskets, hashtags replace pamphlets.

buildup.text: Social media accelerates tax protests. Lebanon's WhatsApp uprising organized in hours.

discovery.text: Cryptocurrency and decentralized finance offer a new form of tax resistance: moving wealth beyond government reach.

twist.text: But governments are adapting too. AI-powered tax enforcement, digital tracking.

climax.text: Tax revolts will continue as long as taxes exist. The tools change.

punchline.text: Muskets to memes. The tools changed. The formula didn't.

quiz.question: What new tool enables modern tax resistance?
